title: Reset From Mid Court (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 136bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
Mid court, both teams moving up
Ball comes fast, time to reset

[Verse 1]
Ball comes hard to the mid court zone
Paddle out front, soft contact zone
Absorb the pace, take the speed away
Block it soft and low, reset the play

Elbow bent, wrist stays firm and still
Paddle face open, pointing up the hill
Feet wide apart, low center holds
Mid court reset, that is how it goes

[Pre-Chorus]
Paddle out front, elbow in
Absorb the pace, let the soft begin
Feet wide, low stance, block the pace
Reset from mid court, hold your space

[Chorus]
Reset from mid court, soft and sure
Paddle out front, contact pure
Absorb the pace, send it low
Reset from mid court, run the flow

[Verse 2]
After the reset, move back to the line
Seven foot kitchen, that is the sign
Two steps forward after the soft block lands
Mid court to kitchen, that is the plan

[Bridge]
Bluey: Beautiful soft hands there at mid court, taking all the pace off
Trevor: The paddle position out front is the key technical element in mid court resets
Michelle: Absorb first. Move forward second. Never in reverse order.

[Chorus]
Reset from mid court, soft and sure
Paddle out front, contact pure
Absorb the pace, send it low
Reset from mid court, run the flow

[Outro]
Absorb first
Move forward second
Reset from mid court
